lines: Hi, I'd like to lower my internet bill. What retention offers are on my account?
I've been a loyal customer for three years, and my bill just went up again.
A competitor offers the same speed for thirty dollars less a month.
Can you match that price — or should I start the cancellation process?
Are there any loyalty discounts you can apply to my account today?
Please confirm the new rate and the exact date it takes effect.
Great — I'll stay if you lock this price in for twelve months.
